title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode6 Juniors and Seniors

meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You've really improved, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks. I've been practicing quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So your "secret training" with Ichika's been paying off?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? I'm not sure I understand...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm sorry, Saki's under the impression that you and Ichika have been practicing in secret.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that why Ichika's singing voice has changed so much?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Her songs have much more power behind them, and her voice sounds more elegant now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That would never happen under normal circumstances. So what did you two do, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, nothing. All she did was ask me for some advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She must've arrived at the answer to whatever was bothering her all by herself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. You've become such an important mentor to her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? I-I have?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. You worked so hard on learning how to help the girls...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Is that true, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: L-Luka...! No one needs to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I do think that you've become a good mentor. Especially compared to when you just met Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry too, Miku. I didn't mean to tease or anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I just never took a step back to think about it is all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I always thought that words like mentor, senior and such suited you two more.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Luka's so mature but also really nice, and MEIKO's so helpful...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm wondering if I can actually fill your shoes... What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't have to fill our shoes, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You can help others in so many different ways.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Someone may find MEIKO to be the most helpful, while others might be more compatible with someone else. In Ichika's case, you're her ideal mentor.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's no real right answer. You should do what you feel is right, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. Being concerned about someone and doing everything you can to help them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what it's all about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've really grown, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Thanks, you two...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, I believe she's just arrived...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... Miku, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds urgent.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We should let them talk.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I can wait until you're finished...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Actually, your timing couldn't be better.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. We were just about to go tune our instruments, so don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ah, I see what they're doing...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's very thoughtful of them to do so...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome, Ichika.
Are you alone today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
There's something that I'd like to talk to you about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
Thank you for lending me an ear the other day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
I'm guessing that things went well after that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They did, and I couldn't have done it without you, Miku. Which is why I want you to hear the difference...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
I'll get ready to play too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Actually, Miku...
If it's alright with you, I'd like you to come to my world this time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your world?
I don't see why not...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's something I'd like you to see.
